about.overview:
At Chamonvin Limited, our clients' priorities come first, every time.

Chamonvin Limited is an international/global sports management firm specializing in soccer, football, and player representation, with extended services in travel and visa consultation.

We represent amateur players, semi-professional players, professional players, managers, and teams. We continuously provide dedicated, high-quality service to our clients, whether on or off the pitch.

We understand what it takes to pursue success at the highest level. We help our clients navigate their careers, identify suitable opportunities, and make informed decisions at every stage of their journey.

Our number-one priority is our clients and their success. Chamonvin Limited is committed to helping clients access suitable opportunities through professional support, communication, and personalized service.
about.mission: To discover, develop, and represent sports talent globally while providing comprehensive travel, visa, and logistics solutions anchored in transparency, trust, and client success.
about.vision: To be recognized globally as a premier, ethical sports management and travel consultancy that empowers athletes and travelers to fulfill their highest potential without borders.
about.philosophy: Our clients' vision and goals stand at the center of everything we do. We offer honest evaluations, long-term career foresight, and meticulous logistical execution.
about.sportsApproach: We take a holistic approach to player development: from technical profiling and tactical awareness to contract negotiation coordination, international network introductions, and life beyond the pitch.
about.travelApproach: We provide seamless, lawful, and personalized guidance for international trips, tours, flights, and visa consultations tailored to athletes, business professionals, students, and families.
about.commitment: Absolute client confidentiality, full transparency in communication, and uncompromising adherence to relevant regulatory and legal frameworks.

news.title: CHAMONVIN Expands Global Player Scouting Network for 2026/27 Season
news.summary: CHAMONVIN LIMITED announces the appointment of senior regional talent coordinators across West Africa, South America, and Central Europe.
news.content:
CHAMONVIN LIMITED is pleased to announce a significant strategic expansion of our international football scouting operations. With our client-first philosophy at the forefront, our newly established scouting desks in Accra, São Paulo, and Munich will provide transparent, direct pathways for exceptional young footballers aiming for international careers.

Our firm provides continuous, end-to-end representation—handling technical player development, contract negotiation coordination, and comprehensive legal and immigration logistics.

Applications for the 2026 international talent review are now open through our official Player Representation portal.
news.author: Chamonvin Editorial Desk

news.title: Navigating International Sports Visas: A Guide for Talents & Families
news.summary: Our immigration advisory division releases key insights into UK and Schengen athletic visitor and trialist visa regulations.
news.content:
Securing legitimate, compliant travel authorization is often the most critical hurdle facing athletes invited for international trials. At CHAMONVIN LIMITED, our visa consultation desk works hand-in-hand with licensed immigration partners to ensure seamless, fully documented visa applications.

Whether preparing standard visitor visas for European showcase matches, short-term training visas, or long-term family relocation packages, our team coordinates every requirement with absolute transparency and confidentiality.
news.author: Chamonvin Immigration Desk

news.title: Registration Now Open: 2026 European Elite Football Showcase Tour
news.summary: Limited spaces are available for our flagship 14-day European trial and scouting expedition across the UK and Spain.
news.content:
CHAMONVIN LIMITED is proud to unveil our flagship European Elite Football Showcase Tour 2026. Designed exclusively for represented and scouted talents aged 16 to 23, the 14-day program will feature competitive matches against top European academies, daily coaching with UEFA Pro staff, and direct exposure to club sporting directors.

Interested players, families, and academy managers are invited to contact our travel consultation team or submit an inquiry through our website.
news.author: Chamonvin Travel Desk
